intro_html: One pot, no draining: penne cooks right in the smoky Cajun tomato broth, then cream cheese melts in to make it silky. Each bowl brings 44 grams of protein at 570 calories for about $3.71 (at everyday cost), and it is still a genuinely cheap full dinner.
cost_closing_html: About $3.71 a bowl (at everyday cost) for creamy Cajun chicken pasta. The chain-restaurant version of this dish runs $15 to $17 a plate, which puts this batch of dinners in real perspective.
shop_smart: The Cajun seasoning is mixed from jars you already own: paprika, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne. The pre-mixed blends charge a premium for the same spoonfuls.
One brick of 1/3 fat cream cheese at $1.19 makes the whole batch creamy. Heavy cream would cost more and add more fat for the same silkiness.
Cooking the penne in the sauce means the starch thickens everything for free, and you skip wasting broth down the drain.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Stir together the Cajun blend: smoked paprika, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, black pepper, and salt.
Cube the chicken breast, toss it with half the spice blend, and sear it in the olive oil and butter in your big pot until browned and cooked to 165 F. Set aside.
Saute the diced onion in the same pot until soft, about 5 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.

Add the penne, diced tomatoes with their juice, chicken broth, and the rest of the spice blend. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Cut the cream cheese into chunks and stir it in off the heat until fully melted and creamy.
Return the chicken and fold in most of the green onions.
Portion into 14 containers and top with the remaining green onions.
portion_html: Set the whole pot on the scale, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Weigh that amount into each container. Every bowl comes out to about 570 calories with 44 grams of protein.

head.description: Easy one-pot creamy Cajun chicken penne meal prep. 14 bowls at 570 calories and 44g protein each, about $3.71 a serving (at everyday cost) vs $16 restaurant pasta.
head.keywords: cajun chicken pasta, one pot pasta, creamy cajun penne, budget meal prep, high protein pasta, cheap dinner recipes
steps: Mix the Cajun spice blend from pantry jars.
Sear seasoned cubed chicken to 165 F and set aside.
Saute onion, then simmer penne with diced tomatoes, broth, and remaining spices until tender.
Stir in cream cheese off the heat until silky, then return the chicken.
Fold in green onions and portion into 14 containers.
